title: Arithmetic Functions (Part 2)

tasks.description: gcd, lcm - implement greatest common divisor and least common multiple
tasks.notes: Implemented in typed/arithmetic.ts for number and bigint types

tasks.description: mod, xgcd - implement modulo and extended GCD algorithm
tasks.notes: mod uses Euclidean modulo (always non-negative). xgcd returns [gcd, x, y] where a*x + b*y = gcd

tasks.description: dotMultiply, dotDivide, dotPow - implement element-wise matrix operations
tasks.notes: Already implemented in individual files using factory pattern for matrix operations

tasks.description: nthRoot, hypot, norm - implement advanced numeric operations
tasks.notes: nthRoot in arithmetic.ts, hypot in trigonometry.ts, norm added with p-norm support (L1, L2, Linf, L0)

tasks.description: Extended arithmetic tests - test GCD/LCM, dot operations, and advanced functions
tasks.notes: 33 tests covering gcd, lcm, mod, xgcd, nthRoot, hypot, norm with various edge cases

successCriteria: GCD/LCM work for integers and BigNumber
Extended GCD produces correct Bezout coefficients
Dot operations work element-wise on matrices
All functions have comprehensive test coverage
notes: Sprint 18 completed. Added xgcd and norm functions. 33 new tests added. Total 126 functions tests passing.
